summary: Kanca ve üç kanıt yapısı sağlam, hollows geri çağrısı ve 'quiet, not finished' çerçevesi güçlü. Ancak ilk dakikada prosedürel bir yavaşlama, orta bölümde geçmişle ilgili büzülme sapması ve zayıf bir kapanış sırası izleyiciyi kaybettirebilir.

issues.quote: The capture did not go perfectly. A software glitch put BepiColombo into safe mode, and the braking burn ended early. [S1] [S3] Its science phase starts in April 2027, so every clue in this video comes from older data, mostly from NASA's MESSENGER, which orbited Mercury from 2011 to 2015.
issues.problem: Hook'tan hemen sonra gelen yazılım arızası, safe mode, 2027 ve MESSENGER bilgisi 20-40. saniyede gerilimi düşürüyor ve soruyu cevaplayan yeni bir şey vermiyor; terk riski burada.
issues.fix: Cut the glitch and safe-mode sentence from the opening. Keep one line: 'Its science work starts in 2027, so every clue here comes from older data, mostly NASA's MESSENGER.' Move the glitch detail to the BepiColombo roadmap section or drop it.

issues.quote: Let me be plain about who says what. The streaks hint at gas loss today. This shrinking study is about the past.
issues.problem: Büzülme bölümü 'ölü mü' sorusuna doğrudan cevap vermiyor ve rakam (16, 23 km, 727 hendek, 300 milyon yıl) yığılıyor; izleyici en çok burada düşer. Anlatıcı kendi bölümünü 'geçmiş' diye küçültüyor.
issues.fix: Open the section with the payoff question: 'Is Mercury still shrinking today?' Then give 23 versus 16 in one sentence and go straight to the 727 trenches and the 'may be refuted by BepiColombo' line. Drop the 'who says what' meta sentence or fold it into one short clause.

issues.quote: That is more than two Everests, not removed, but squeezed, as the crust folded over itself.
issues.problem: Everest yükseklik, 23 km ise genişlik/yarıçap kaybı; karşılaştırma uzman olmayan için kafa karıştırıcı ve cümle ritmi TTS için dağınık. Ayrıca 'width' kullanımı bilimsel olarak belirsiz.
issues.fix: Say: 'The new study says up to twenty three. Earlier estimates said sixteen. The planet's radius shrank by about that much, more than two Everests stacked.' Verify the radius versus width wording against S6 before keeping the Everest comparison.

issues.quote:
The next step is close. On 9 December, the two orbiters are due to separate. [S1]

The honest answer today is that we do not know yet.
issues.problem: Güçlü 'tek oyuk kenarı değişirse' düşüncesinden sonra teknik bir ayrılma tarihiyle devam etmek duygusal doruğu söndürüyor; 9 Aralık tarihi ayrıca research.md'de doğrulanmamış. Kapanış CTA ve yorum sorusuyla bitiyor, yansıtıcı bir son cümle yok.
issues.fix: Move the 9 December line before the 'My guess is' paragraph (or into the roadmap section), only if verified. End with the reflective beat: 'One small shift in one hollow would turn a clue into a measurement.' Then the one-line subscribe and the comment question.

issues.quote: One of these clues is a set of bright streaks nobody can fully explain yet.
issues.problem: Merak boşluğu hemen ardından 'volatile loss' açıklamasıyla kısmen kapanıyor; vaat edilen gizem küçülüyor.
issues.fix: Reframe the gap: 'bright streaks that appear to point to gas escaping from the rock, and nobody has ever watched one form.' Or keep the line and make the 'nobody has watched a streak form' beat land harder.

issues.quote: Think about what it would mean if the edge of a single hollow had moved. Not a theory about the past, but a change we could point to, between two sets of pictures. That one small shift would turn a clue into a measurement.
issues.problem: Hemen üstteki 'A hollow edge that moved' ile tekrar ediyor; tempo yavaşlıyor.
issues.fix: Merge the two: delete 'A hollow edge that moved. A streak that was not there before.' from the guess paragraph, or cut the first sentence of this paragraph and keep 'That one small shift would turn a clue into a measurement.'

issues.quote: Now the caution. About ninety three percent of the streaks are in the north, and the team ties that to how well MESSENGER imaged each region. About ten percent are not in craters at all, so other mechanisms may be at work.
issues.problem: İki oran art arda, uzun ve cümle içinde bağlaç yüklü; TTS'de nefessiz okunur ve izleyici için rakam fazlası.
issues.fix: Split: 'Now the caution. Ninety three percent of the streaks are in the north. The team says that likely reflects where MESSENGER imaged best.' Drop the ten percent figure or give it its own short sentence.

issues.quote: In 2026, new studies added to a decade of hints that Mercury may not be fully dead.
issues.problem: Bölüm 'üç alan' (streaks, shrinking, volcanism) olarak önceden sayılmıyor; izleyici yol haritasını bilmiyor, orta kısımda nerede olduğunu kaybediyor.
issues.fix: Add a signpost: 'Three areas of evidence: streaks, shrinking, and volcanism.' Then use 'the second' and 'the third' as already done.

issues.quote: Be careful here. These are conference abstracts. They are not peer reviewed papers.
issues.problem: Üçüncü kez art arda temkin vurgusu (Now the caution / Plausible, not proven / Be careful here) ritmi kalıplaştırıyor.
issues.fix: Vary the third caveat: 'A warning on the source: these are conference abstracts, not peer reviewed papers, and they describe deposits, not eruptions.' One sentence, no 'Be careful here'.

issues.problem: Süre: metin yaklaşık 1050 kelime, yani 140 wpm ile yaklaşık 7,5 dakika; kanal varsayılanı 10 dakika. Kısa olması bir kusur değil ama gereksiz bölümler budanırken uzunluk sorun olmaz.
issues.fix: Do not pad. Keep the length near 7 to 8 minutes after trimming and state the target length in the production notes.
